about: Chat 9 round 11 (HQ Oct 28 12:44 AM, chat 8's Midwest maps survey): Ohio DNR's gis2.ohiodnr.gov outline layers (parks + wildlife areas). The key already reads ODNR_ODNR_Lands_Public_nolakes layers 5-8 on gis.ohiodnr.gov: is gis2 newer / fuller (dates, counts, names)? Ohio is on the 2-fer line: nothing changes until its verdict.
